definition: A durable unit of project knowledge with exactly one Lattice spec as its source of truth.
name: Canonical project fact

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable Lattice identifier used by other artifacts when they refer to the fact.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Team, module, or project area responsible for maintaining the fact.

relationships: May be referenced by rules, examples, tests, plans, code comments, or generated docs.
description: Defines the Canonical project fact domain object and explains how other specs should refer to it.
